I changed nothing this pass. All 10 FEBio runs are moving, and the 32-core CPU quota is the bottleneck (31.8 of 32 cores in use, the job is held back about 171 s out of every 10 s).

- **Resources:** the runs are pinned to 62 cores in total, with no overlap. The newest run (p143, started 03:16) briefly shared two cores with p135, and the pinning service moved it to free cores within seconds. Memory is 135.3 of 137.4 GB, but only 25.5 GB is program data; the rest is file cache the system can free. There have been no new out-of-memory kills (still 2). /raid has 2.3 TB free.
- **GPUs:**
  - GPU 0: 7%
  - GPU 1: 0%
  - GPU 2: 12% (another user holds 16.9 GB on it)
  - GPU 3: 8%
  - GPU 4: idle
  - GPUs 5 and 6: another user's

  More GPU runs would only split the same 32 cores, so I didn't add any.
- **Old FEBio queue:** 1 waiting (p148, since 22:45 yesterday), 5 running, 2668 done, 2 failed. 3 runs finished in the last hour (p092, p113, p125), and all three ended normally.
- **New-repo task queue:** empty and nothing running (1 done, 5 failed from before).
- **Health:** every run's log was written in the last few seconds, so nothing is hung or dead. Every needed tmux service is up. The ones in `ops/resume_all.sh` that aren't running are finished lanes marked done.
